name: Goal Check-In & Adjustment
instructions: Revisit the SMART goal you set earlier in the program and honestly assess your progress toward it.
If a goal turned out to be unrealistic, adjust the target rather than abandoning it entirely -- adjustment is not failure.
Set one small, concrete action for the final two days of the program that moves that goal forward.
Watch today's video as a refresher on setting goals you will actually keep working toward.
